### Policy value under the sample scorer

Pseudo-golden = our own plan with the true account, 199 evidence-established cases whose account is verified absent (56 more are left out because the account is still present: a residual, unobserved account is never one), scored with `score.score` (the sample scorer). Only the account step can differ.

| policy | status acc | step P / R / F1 | field step_no | field resource_id | seq overlap | positional | exact cases |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| omit | 199/199 | 1.000 / 0.926 / 0.9614 | 0.715 | 0.926 | 0.894 | 0.715 | 105/199 |
| hybrid | 199/199 | 0.977 / 0.961 / 0.9685 | 0.918 | 0.961 | 0.941 | 0.918 | 149/199 |
| guess | 199/199 | 0.967 / 0.965 / 0.9660 | 0.964 | 0.965 | 0.947 | 0.964 | 155/199 |

## Anonymized analytics profiles (worker-cadence heuristic)

### Cadence heuristic: what can be backtested

- Hiding evidence links (as for accounts) is **not possible**: 0 cases have a compliant, identifier-free analytics profile that evidence links to them. An anonymized profile carries no identifier, so evidence never links it; that is why the matcher exists (125 cases are matched by it).
- The only ground truth for these profiles is the golden answers of the COMPLETE sample cases, reported below. It is a small sample, so read the accuracy as 'no failure observed', not as a rate.

#### Sample truth, policy hybrid

| candidates before cadence | cadence | cases | right | decided by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | on | 2 | 2 | 2 elimination |
| 2 | on | 5 | 5 | 5 elimination |
| 1 | off | 2 | 2 | 2 elimination |
| 2 | off | 5 | 5 | 5 guess |

Whole dataset (samples + eval): analytics guesses with cadence on 24, off 48; cadence narrowed 14 cases; learned gaps [390, 449].

#### Sample truth, policy guess

| candidates before cadence | cadence | cases | right | decided by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | on | 2 | 2 | 2 elimination |
| 2 | on | 5 | 5 | 5 elimination |
| 1 | off | 2 | 2 | 2 elimination |
| 2 | off | 5 | 5 | 5 guess |

Whole dataset (samples + eval): analytics guesses with cadence on 24, off 48; cadence narrowed 14 cases; learned gaps [390, 449].

#### Premise check on evidence-linked resources (no hidden links, no analytics guessing)

- Consecutive worker events of a case's linked resources: 421 pairs; the four most common gaps [1169, 1110, 449, 390] s cover 414 of them (top five with counts: [(1169, 164), (1110, 144), (449, 57), (390, 49), (4481, 1)]).
- Evidence-linked analytics profiles with a linked predecessor: 47; gap distribution [(1169, 30), (1110, 15), (449, 1), (4540, 1)]. These profiles sit in the same alternating-gap pattern, which is the premise the cadence heuristic relies on.
